{"rule": "Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and a new passage of about 250 words in the text field.", "text": "The letters stayed under the paperweight through November. Desmond did not read them again, but he knew where they were in the way one knows where a draught is coming from.

The drains were dug up in the first week of December. Men in orange stood in a trench outside the window and the shop filled with the smell of wet clay and cold. Fewer regulars came. Ines came, stamping her boots on the mat, and asked what the digging was for, and he told her the truth, which was that he had not read the letter closely enough to say.

She found a chair near the atlases and did not open a book. After a while she said that the flat above the laundrette had been sold and that the new owners were something to do with a firm, she could not remember the name, and Desmond said that he could probably guess it.

He made coffee for them both on the ring behind the counter. The radio was giving the shipping forecast, which neither of them needed and both of them listened to. Outside, a man in the trench laughed at something, and the sound came up through the floor.

When she left, Ines bought a small book of Portuguese verse she had not looked at, and he understood that it was a kind of vote. He lifted the paperweight, read the second letter to the end, and put it back. Then he wrote HOURS VARY on a card in his own hand and propped it in the window, as if the brass plate needed corroborating."}
